summary: The ordinary Writer Paragraph command reaches the named list-style template, whose edits preserve document ownership and undo. The graphic gallery and Customize exchange the native per-level bitmap values through rendering and ODT.
findings: All scope-specific checks passed. Repository-wide JSDoc and size checks still report pre-existing findings outside the changed files.
evidence_refs: 215 focused Writer checks, 12 shared checks, two production Chrome tests and a production build
Targeted named and automatic ODT image-marker round trips, Worker graph round trip, and typed UNO property sequence
residual_risks: Browser line-box rendering approximates desktop placement and inherits the PNG/JPEG scope of the existing ODT package graphic service.
